OpenAI raises $122 billion to accelerate the next phase of AI

Today, we closed our latest funding round with $122 billion in committed capital at a post money valuation of $852 billion.

OpenAI is becoming the core infrastructure for AI, making it possible for people around the world and businesses to build things faster.

Deep conviction across global capital

Our strategic partners Amazon, NVIDIA, and SoftBank participated in the round alongside Microsoft and other long-term investors.
